verdict.rationale: Customer.io's automations are event-driven workflows that send messages and change data. The docs say they can trigger when profiles perform events or join segments. AI-native users can have an assistant build and manage these automations through the official MCP server and CLI, and the in-product agent can run recurring tasks on a schedule. A community user also praised the intuitive workflow building. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger conditions and filters (the four automation components are not described in the evidence), and independent hands-on corroboration of AI-built event-triggered automations.
